questions.question: When driving a bus with passengers, what should the driver do?

options.text: Talk with passengers if they want to talk.

questions.explanation: A driver must keep passengers safe. Talking with passengers can distract the driver and cause accidents. Bus drivers should focus on driving.

questions.question: Black ice is:
questions.explanation: Black ice is thin and clear. You can see the road through it. It looks like a wet road. Watch for black ice when the temperature is below freezing and the road looks wet.

questions.question: What will the examiner score you on during the driving test?

options.text: How fast you reach your destination.

questions.explanation: The examiner will score you on specific driving moves and your overall driving behavior.

questions.question: What determines your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?
questions.explanation: Your BAC depends mainly on how much alcohol you drink, how fast you drink it, and your body weight.

questions.question: Pre-trip inspections are:

options.text: Needed only for trips longer than 100 miles.

questions.explanation: Federal and state laws require you to inspect your vehicle before every trip, no matter how short.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should use turn signals:

options.text: Only when another vehicle is near you.

questions.explanation: Always signal before turning or changing lanes. Do not assume other drivers will move just because you are signaling.

questions.question: Truck drivers must carry emergency equipment that includes:
questions.explanation: Truck drivers must carry emergency warning equipment. This includes three red reflective triangles, six fuses, or three liquid burning flares.

questions.question: How should you drive a large truck to avoid slowing down traffic?

options.text: Try to pass another vehicle while driving uphill.
Stay in the right lane when possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane when possible.
questions.explanation: If your truck cannot keep up with traffic speed because of a heavy load, stay in the right lane.

questions.question: When driving down a hill, you can reduce braking by:
questions.explanation: Before going downhill, slow down and shift to a lower gear. This helps control your vehicle without using the brakes too much. Using brakes too much downhill can make them overheat and fail.

questions.question: Emergency roof hatches on a bus:

options.text: Must be closed before the bus moves.
Can be opened to bring in fresh air while driving.
Must be removed before the bus moves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be opened to bring in fresh air while driving.
questions.explanation: Some emergency roof hatches on a bus can be locked open to allow fresh air in. However, this should not be done regularly.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a warning sign of fatigue?
questions.explanation: Warning signs of fatigue include: difficulty focusing, frequent blinking, heavy eyelids, repeated yawning, rubbing your eyes, daydreaming, wandering thoughts, trouble remembering the last few miles, missing exits or signs, trouble keeping your head up, drifting from your lane, following too closely, hitting a shoulder rumble strip, and feeling restless or irritable.

questions.question: Talking on a cell phone while driving removes about ____ of a person's focus from driving.
questions.explanation: Talking on a cell phone while driving takes away about 39 percent of a driver's mental focus from the road.

questions.question: Wheels with welding repairs are:

options.text: Safe to use if a professional did the repairs.
Safe to use if the repair looks solid.

questions.explanation: Wheels or rims with welding repairs are not safe to drive on. They must be replaced before the vehicle is used on the road.

questions.question: An encroachment is when:

options.text: A driver misses their scheduled basic skills test.
A vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
A driver fails one part of the basic skills test.

questions.correctAnswerText: A vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
questions.explanation: An encroachment during the basic vehicle control skills test happens when a boundary line is touched or crossed by any part of the vehicle. Each encroachment counts as an error.

questions.question: ____ is an example of required emergency equipment.
questions.explanation: All commercial motor vehicles must have emergency equipment. This includes spare electrical fuses, three red reflective triangles (or six fuses, or three liquid burning flares), and at least one properly charged and rated fire extinguisher.

questions.question: When re-entering traffic after a bus stop, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will let you merge back into traffic.
Wait for a gap large enough to accelerate and merge safely.
Have a passenger stop traffic so you can merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough to accelerate and merge safely.
questions.explanation: When driving a bus, wait for a large enough gap in traffic before re-entering the road. Make sure you have enough space to accelerate and merge safely.

questions.question: When visibility is poor and you are near other drivers, you should:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when visibility is poor, such as at dawn, dusk, or in bad weather. High beams can make it hard for other drivers to see.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing, you should:

options.text: Rely on warning signals to tell you if a train is coming.
Rely on other drivers' actions to tell you if a train is coming.
Not rely only on warning signals to tell you if a train is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not rely only on warning signals to tell you if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: Do not rely only on warning signals, gates, or flaggers to alert you to an approaching train. Be especially alert at crossings without gates or signals. Always assume a train could be coming.

questions.question: When turning, when should you cancel the turn signal?
questions.explanation: Keep your turn signal on the entire time you are turning. Cancel it only after the turn is finished.

questions.question: When leaving your vehicle, you should:

options.text: Not apply brakes if the vehicle is out of gear.

questions.explanation: Always apply the parking brake when you park. If needed, chock the wheels.
